descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-19 ER 3-5, 8; TFA-92597 rules 2-7 · “Hold/stop dates and reasons are the ones dictated, never changed to the save date.”. Mixed: stated part — hold, dose rename with history, stop, Given, start-as-plan, rows from earlier days keep their date; our part — 0 / 1 / 15 rows on file and two changes in one dictation (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B06 · S0 · known

After dictating 'furosemide down to 20', the tracker row still says 'Furosemide 40'; the dose is not updated

Tickets: TFA-92597 ready for qa (R7) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-19/S07, TC-19/S28

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S11 Encounter/visit path edges: 0/1/15 rows, two changes at once, each step class in Nursing Home, and rows dated on earlier days

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 A dose change renames the row to the new dose and keeps its history (the old dose stays readable on the row). (UAT TC-19 ER 4; TFA-92597 R7)
  • U8 Hold/stop dates and reasons are the ones dictated and are kept on every later save; they are never changed to the save date. (UAT TC-19 ER 5; UAT TC-19 ER 10; TFA-92597 R6)
  • U9 No phantom or aggregate rows ('IV abx', 'beta blocker'). (UAT TC-19 ER 6; TFA-92597 R9)
  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated. (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 R5)
  • U4 'Continue / keep / stays on X' is not an event: no re-dating, no Held, no new row. (UAT TC-19 ER 1; TFA-92597 R4)
  • U6 'Let's start X' is a plan: it becomes a task, not a row. (UAT TC-19 ER 3; TFA-92597 R3)
  • U11 'Gave one-time X' → a single-dose row shown as Given that expires; the standing order of the same drug is untouched. (UAT TC-19 ER 8; TFA-92597 R2)
  • U12 Nursing Home has its own Medications panel, filled from the pre-round (PR #56). (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 AC 3)
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-19 Steps; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Rows on file: none, one, fifteen; Nursing Home rows on file for each step class; rows held, stopped or active with dates from earlier days (Oct 10, Oct 11, Apr 12)

When Send each dictation through the path named in the fixture. For Nursing Home, 'encounter' is the visit extraction that Generate Note & Finish runs (extractMedicationEvents + mergeMedEventsIntoList), since Save & Extract there updates tasks only (Q8)

Then B-0: no row from 'home meds'. B-1-hold: one row, held, reason names creatinine. B-1-dose: one row whose name carries 20 and whose reason keeps 40 (on both paths). B-15: still 15 rows, pantoprazole Stopped with its reason, the other 14 untouched. B-2: metoprolol and lisinopril held, one new midodrine row Started, count 3. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): rowCount, rows, untouched, noRow and unchanged per fixture; each fixture is its own Pass/Fail (not an AI Check line). B-1-dose and N-dose on the encounter path are expected to expose the missing rename on the event merge (risk 4, Q18). Rows dated Oct 10 / Oct 11 / Apr 12 stand in for day 2 (U18), so a row re-dated to the save date fails. …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (blocked)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.
